title: CUSA03562
notes: English first: initial street conversations after character creation, including descriptive NPC labels and choices. Source constant order does not certify event order. Human context and HUD layout review pending. Portuguese intentionally not drafted yet.

entries.en: I should've trusted the weather forecast and brought an umbrella.
It really is pouring. It's been raining for days.
It's chilly, even though it's spring.
It seems to be coming from the intersection. What on earth...?
Ask, "What are you so upset about?"
Get annoyed: "You didn't have to shove me that hard!"
Ignore him and walk away without a word.
You're asking what I'm so upset about?

How peaceful this world is!
Everyone complains, but then they just accept it and move on.

A boring world where people can live with their complaints drives me mad.
I wish something big would happen.
Now that you understand, leave me alone!

I thought I heard a bang,
but I'm not listening to anything right now.
So don't talk to me.
I can't take it... I want to come clean and get this off my chest...
It sounded like something made a loud noise over at the intersection...

Come on, give me a straight answer.
You've been seeing that woman again, haven't you?!

...What's going on...? It sounds noisy outside...
Oh! Welcome!
How about some freshly fried karaage?
entries.notes: Karaage is the Japanese fried chicken offered by this clerk; keep the setting's food name.
